visualCharacteristics.purpose: Full-width band pairing a lifestyle or product photo with explanatory copy
visualCharacteristics.layout: 50/50 split, no card chrome; photo cell fills its half and may sit on either side (cell order follows authoring); text cell vertically centered. Photo stacks on top below 900px
visualCharacteristics.notes: Text cell may hold an H2, paragraphs, a list of icon items (:icon: beside a bold H3 and copy) and a CTA. Icon items are grouped from the authored :icon: paragraph plus the following H3 and paragraphs.

contentPattern.structure: one row, two cells: a picture-only cell and a text cell, in either order
rows: H2, then repeated :icon: paragraph + H3 + paragraph, then CTA link

usage.description: Explainer and how-to bands on deposit product promo pages (image left or right).

reuseGuidance: Use for an edge-to-edge 50/50 photo-beside-text band, optionally with icon items. For a rounded, shadowed promo card use columns-media-card; for plain columns use the base columns block.
